findings.location: Throughout: the five-item list; “Restorationism” section heading and its paragraphs; Conclusion
findings.source_quote: “Restorationism”; “Restorationism looks back at earlier times”; “restorationist movements”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a consistent Urdu term distinguishing restorationism from revivalism, such as “بحالی پسندی” (and “بحالی پسند” for restorationists), in the list, heading, and all related prose. For example: change “احیائے نو پسندی” to “بحالی پسندی.”
findings.translation_quote: “احیائے نو پسندی”; “احیائے نو پسندی ماضی کے اُن ادوار کی طرف دیکھتی ہے”; “احیائے نو پسند تحریکوں”

findings.location: Christocentrism section, paragraph beginning “An example of this sort of ‘Christocentrism’”
findings.source_quote: “many professed Christians today who do not want to align themselves with this or that teaching in the epistles.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “رسالوں” with “رسولی خطوط” or “خطوط” to refer to the New Testament epistles.
findings.translation_quote: “آج بہت سے مسیحیت کا دعویٰ کرنے والے لوگ جو رسالوں کی فلاں یا فلاں تعلیم سے خود کو وابستہ نہیں کرنا چاہتے”
